prompt.alinti: You can turn Claude into an absolute monster in designing websites with these free five plugins. First is Taste. It's basically built to stop Claude from giving you a generic AI-looking UI. Then there's Impeccable, which goes even further by giving Claude an actual design system to work from. Plus, a live editor where you can tweak everything in your browser. Third is the Playwright CLI. Instead of manually checking whether everything Claude built actually works, it can spin up multiple browsers and test your websites for you. Then there's Awesome Design, which gives Claude the design systems behind sites like Notion, includes their typography, spacing, buttons, components, so you can use the same principles in your designs. And finally, Image23.js can take normal images and recreate the object in an interactive 3D model entirely with code. All five are completely free, common design.
